excerpt: Maggie Lenhart wrote that she manages the Del Taco relationship on the Worldpay side and is working through Del Taco’s contract renewal. Bryan Bailey mentioned that someone from Genius had a productive conversation with Daniel Meers at Genius World. Maggie asked to learn more about the discussion and requested an introduction to the individual who spoke with Daniel, hoping it could strengthen the broader Global Payments relationship and support future opportunities. Tracy Gallimore replied that she spoke briefly with Daniel before he departed, that he sounded like he had a good event and wants to know more about what a partnership looks like, and recommended scheduling a team call to review and strategize on next steps. Tracy also noted Todd Vahlsing was hired to partner with the Worldpay team on cross-sell opportunities.
